summary: Iteration 18 — retest of the single-Modal collapse fix for ProfilePrivacyBlockRows. Tested as Alice (test_alice_73dc7f@test.com) against Bob in thread 4f3c5028-706f-43fa-a57b-494b13787718 on the public preview URL. PRIMARY REGRESSION IS FIXED — collapsing the two sibling <Modal>s into a single Modal whose body branches on `sheet.kind` ('pin' | 'confirm') restored pointer-event delivery to the Lock + Block rows. The PIN sheet (chat-profile-lock-pin) now opens correctly on tap, PATCH /api/chat/lock/threads is fired with the correct payload, and the backend persists the lock. HOWEVER two follow-on issues emerged: (A) **markUnlocked-before-reload fix DOES NOT work** — immediately after locking from inside the open chat, the user is still bounced to <ChatLockGate>. The screenshot at /app/test_reports/iter18_screenshots/05_after_lock.png shows the 'This chat is locked' gate, exactly the bounce the fix was supposed to prevent. (B) No-PIN nag confirm did NOT render on first attempt — tapping chat-profile-lock with has_pin=false produced no confirm modal (chat-profile-confirm-ok not visible, 'Set up chat lock first' text count = 0). The click handler IS firing (TEST 2 with PIN configured worked end-to-end) so the no-PIN branch of toggleLock is either not rendering the confirm Modal or the modal is being mounted then immediately dismissed. Also a minor UI quirk: on a fresh mount of /chat/{id}, the FIRST tap on chat-header-profile sometimes does not open the profile modal (had to click twice). Once profile is open, single Lock / Block / Wallpaper taps all work. Block + Wallpaper flows were not fully exercised because TEST 2's lock-bounce sent the next navigation back through the locked gate; the click-restoration itself is verified by the working PIN sheet.

ui_bugs.issue: After PATCH /api/chat/lock/threads succeeds, the chat screen IS bounced to ChatLockGate ('This chat is locked'). Calling markUnlocked(threadId) BEFORE await reload() does not prevent the gate from mounting. Screenshot proof: /app/test_reports/iter18_screenshots/05_after_lock.png. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:741-755 (submitLock) and /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:209 (gate gating). Likely cause: the `alreadyUnlocked` check at line 209 uses `wpSettings.isUnlocked(threadId)` whose `useCallback` deps are []. isUnlocked reads from unlockedRef.current.has(key), which IS updated by markUnlocked — but the gate's parent render reads the value BEFORE markUnlocked propagates because reload() triggers a settings state update whose new render evaluates isUnlocked through the memoized context value (recomputed when settings changes). Possible mitigation: also set the local `unlockedThisSession` state (line 94) inside submitLock — e.g. `setUnlockedThisSession(true); markUnlocked(threadId); await reload();`. The local-state path is OR-ed with isUnlocked at line 209 and is guaranteed to be true on the next render regardless of context memoization timing.

Tapping chat-profile-lock when settings.has_pin is false did NOT surface the unified confirm Modal with title 'Set up chat lock first' and CTA 'Open Settings'. chat-profile-confirm-ok was not visible and 'Set up chat lock first' text count = 0. The PIN-gated branch (TEST 2) works perfectly with the same component, so toggleLock IS being called — but the confirm Modal is not appearing. Suspected race: useChatSettings may still be in loading=true / settings=null state when the click happens; toggleLock at line 727 does `!settings?.has_pin` which is `true` for null, so the confirm SHOULD be set — but possibly the Modal is mounted then immediately torn down because settings re-render reverts state. Repro: from a cold load with no PIN configured, open profile → tap Lock → confirm modal absent. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/iter18_screenshots/02_nopin_FAIL.png.

On a fresh mount of /chat/{id}, the FIRST tap on chat-header-profile sometimes does not open the profile Modal — a second tap is needed. Subsequent profile opens (after another navigation) also typically need 2 taps. Minor UX quirk; not blocking but worth investigating. Could be that the first synthetic click happens before the Modal Provider has fully hydrated for the freshly mounted screen.

integration_issues.issue: Verified: PATCH /api/chat/lock/threads returns 200 and backend persists locked_thread_ids. BUT the UI bounces to ChatLockGate instead of remaining in the chat with the row label flipped to 'Chat locked'. The markUnlocked(threadId) call at /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:749 (before await reload()) is in place but does NOT prevent the bounce on web. See ui_bugs entry — recommend ALSO calling setUnlockedThisSession(true) — but that state lives in the parent component, so submitLock can't reach it directly. The cleanest fix is to lift unlockedThisSession into useChatSettings (so markUnlocked can flip both the ref AND a state flag in one go) or to expose a setter callback prop down to ProfilePrivacyBlockRows.

Unable to verify end-to-end because the no-PIN confirm Modal does not render on first attempt. With PIN configured, the same row triggers the PIN sheet correctly — so the click handler fires but the confirm branch is broken or racing with settings load.

Not verified end-to-end this iteration. The early-bounce to ChatLockGate in TEST 2 prevented reaching the chat for TEST 3. The Block row should now respond to taps (click regression itself is fixed — proven by PIN sheet opening), but the post-Block re-fetch flow could not be reproduced inside this run.

action_items: FIX the lock-then-bounce regression. The cleanest patch: in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx ProfilePrivacyBlockRows, accept an `onLocked` prop from ChatThreadScreen, and call it inside submitLock() right before reload() — ChatThreadScreen wires it to `() => setUnlockedThisSession(true)`. This guarantees the gate at line 210 sees alreadyUnlocked=true on the next render regardless of context memoization timing. Alternative: lift `unlockedThisSession` into useChatSettings (rename to a sessionUnlockedRef inside the provider) so markUnlocked alone is sufficient.

FIX the no-PIN confirm not rendering. Add a small guard: in toggleLock, return early if settings is still null (loading); show a transient toast 'Please wait…' or simply ignore. Verify chat-profile-confirm-ok renders for has_pin=false by re-running TEST 1 after settings has fully loaded (e.g., add a useEffect+ready flag). May also be worth confirming the Modal visibility prop isn't being clobbered by an immediate setSheet(null) downstream.

Optional polish: investigate why the FIRST tap on chat-header-profile is sometimes swallowed on a fresh mount (works on 2nd tap). Possibly the same RN-Web Modal-portal hydration race that the single-Modal collapse addressed elsewhere.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:706-710 — single discriminated `sheet` state with ConfirmPayload | PinPayload. Correct and the regression-fix approach matches iteration-17 reviewer's recommendation.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:838-884 — single <Modal visible={!!sheet}> with body branching on sheet?.kind. Markup is clean and testIDs are intact (chat-profile-lock-pin, chat-profile-lock-confirm, chat-profile-confirm-ok, chat-profile-confirm-cancel). Click-regression confirmed FIXED by PIN sheet opening on Lock tap.

/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:741-755 (submitLock) — markUnlocked(threadId) is called BEFORE await reload() as documented, but in practice does NOT prevent the parent ChatThreadScreen from mounting <ChatLockGate>. Root cause is that ChatThreadScreen also tracks a local `unlockedThisSession` state (line 94/209) which markUnlocked cannot touch. Recommend lifting that state into useChatSettings or passing an onLocked callback prop.

/app/frontend/src/chat-settings.tsx:132-136 — markUnlocked mutates a Ref (no re-render trigger). On its own this is fine for the chat-list gating, but when the gate-evaluation happens during the SAME tick as the settings state update (post-reload), the gate component may evaluate isUnlocked BEFORE the ref-mutation order — though Refs are synchronous, so this is suspicious; the more likely issue is that the gate is evaluated in a parent render that already passed before markUnlocked was called. Worth tracing with a console.log inside isUnlocked to confirm.

Minor: no-PIN confirm path at /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:726-739 — toggleLock dereferences settings?.has_pin which is undefined when settings is null (loading). The `!undefined` evaluates to true so the confirm should be set. The fact that it doesn't render at all suggests either the Modal is immediately torn down or the confirm payload's render path has a runtime error (worth inspecting console). Suggest adding a console.log inside toggleLock and checking the browser console during the no-PIN attempt.

rca_of_issue: PRIMARY FIX VERIFIED: single Modal with discriminated `sheet` state restored pointer-event delivery to the Lock row (confirmed by PIN sheet opening on tap and PATCH /chat/lock/threads firing). RESIDUAL BUG #1 (lock-bounce): ChatThreadScreen line 209 reads `alreadyUnlocked = wpSettings.isUnlocked(threadId) || unlockedThisSession`. submitLock calls markUnlocked which mutates a ref inside useChatSettings — fine — but it does NOT touch `unlockedThisSession` (local state in ChatThreadScreen). After reload(), settings.locked_thread_ids includes threadId → isThreadLocked returns true. Now the question is whether isUnlocked(threadId) returns true on the next render. It SHOULD because the ref is mutated synchronously. However, the gate is rendered by ChatThreadScreen (a parent of ProfilePrivacyBlockRows), and React re-renders flow top-down; when the context-provider value changes due to reload(), the parent re-renders and reads `isUnlocked` from the NEW context value. The new isUnlocked is a useCallback with deps []; its closure captures the same unlockedRef which DOES have threadId. So isUnlocked(threadId) SHOULD return true. Yet the screenshot proves the gate appears. Most-likely explanation: between the markUnlocked call and the next render, something resets unlockedRef. Looking at chat-settings.tsx — unlockedRef is reset only inside clearUnlocks() and on cold mount of the provider. If the user navigation causes the provider to unmount/remount, the ref is fresh-empty and the gate appears. Investigating the layout tree — ChatSettingsProvider lives in a root layout, so it should NOT unmount during /chat/[id] re-renders. ALTERNATIVE explanation: the ref is fine but the gate is rendered via SafeAreaView whose render closure captured the OLD isUnlocked before markUnlocked was called. Unlikely with hooks + useMemo, but worth verifying with a console.log inside isUnlocked('threadId') from the gate's render path. RESIDUAL BUG #2 (no-PIN confirm not rendering): the click handler fires (proven by TEST 2). toggleLock with settings.has_pin=false should setSheet({kind:'confirm',...}). The Modal would then re-render with visible=!!sheet → true and the confirm body. But chat-profile-confirm-ok is not visible. Could be: (a) the Modal re-render happens but the body has a runtime error in the destructuring (`sheet.title`, `sheet.body`, `sheet.ctaLabel` — these all exist on ConfirmPayload), (b) the previous TEST's leftover state caused a different code path, (c) settings is still null at click time and the Modal opens then immediately closes when settings flips to loaded (race). Recommend adding a defensive `if (!settings) return;` to toggleLock and re-testing. Reproduction & mitigation are spelled out in the action_items + context_for_next_testing_agent fields.
